test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is "**Millenium**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the correct spelling and meaning of the word.
 
• **Millennium**: a period of a thousand years, especially when calculated from the traditional date of the birth of Christ.
 
 
• **Example**: *Her grandparents lived long enough to see the new **millennium**__.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

 
• Let's look at the correct spelling and meaning of the word.
 
• **Millennium:**** **एक हजार साल की अवधि, खासकर जब मसीह के जन्म की पारंपरिक तारीख से गणना की जाती है।

7d:T8b5,

The correct answer is "**such**"
